title: NextGen Farms
address: NextGen Farms, Opposite RD Resorts, Bhiwani-Jind Road, near Tigrana Mod, Bhiwani, Haryana
shortDescription: 37 farmhouse plots in a gated countryside community, 0.4 km from Tigrana Mod on the Bhiwani–Jind Road.
description: Own a piece of the countryside in NextGen Farms: an exclusive collection of 37 farmhouse plots in multiple sizes, planned to suit both your lifestyle and your investment goals across 5.8 acres.

This thoughtfully planned gated community offers a 35 ft wide access road, reliable water and electricity connections, a modern sewage treatment plant, round-the-clock security with guard rooms and CCTV surveillance, and a dedicated cycling track for health and leisure.
